 This application coming on for admission this day, the

 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.33/2024 dated 15.01.2024 registered at Police Station Kolar Road, District Bhopal for the offences under Sections 366, 376(2)(n) and 506/34 of IPC.
2.

The counsel for the applicant submits that the the prosecution is trying to implicate the present applicant on the ground that he was instrumental in providing aid to co-accused Harsh Meena to commit rape with the prosecutrix.
It is contended by the counsel that the prosecution nowhere says that the present applicant has committed any offence with the prosecutrix.

The prosecutrix is a major and out of her own free will, she entered into wedlock with co-accused Harsh Meena and in support of, photographs of marriage have been brought on record as Annexure A/2 by the applicant.

It is further contended by the counsel that despite the marriage on 15.07.20223, no action had taken Ashish Meena @ Kailash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149307287/
1 by the prosecutrix and later on, in the month of January, 2024, the First Information Report has been lodged by the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 16.01.2024 thus, the applicant be released on bail.

3. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the said prayer and submitted that the present applicant in his car had taken the prosecutrix to a place where she was subjected to commission of rape at the behest of co-accused Harsh Meena.
Thus, considering the role of the present applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail.
4. Heard the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perused the case diary.

5. A perusal of case diary it reflects that the prosecutrix in her statement admitted that she was known to co-accused Harsh Meena and on 15.07.2023 she was married to co-accused Harsh Meena and thereafter, the First Information Report has been lodged in the month of January 2024 while detailing in incident dated 06.01.2024 where again according to prosecutrix she was subjected to rape at the behest of co-accused Harsh Meena.

It is undisputed that the applicant is in custody since 16.01.2024.
6.
Thus, taking into consideration the totality of the circumstances and also the role attributed to the present applicant, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
9. C.c. as per rules.

(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE sp Ashish Meena @ Kailash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149307287/
